title: Indian Technical and Economic Cooperation (ITEC) Programme
description: A fully funded Government of India programme offering short professional training courses to working professionals from 161 partner countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America, Eastern Europe, and the Pacific. Around 10,000 course seats are offered annually across more than 100 Indian institutes, spanning fields like public administration, IT, entrepreneurship, agriculture, environment, and more -- each specific course has its own subject, host institute, and dates, published on a rolling basis on the official ITEC portal. India covers international airfare, accommodation, tuition, and a living allowance for selected candidates; there is no cost to the participant. Applications are not submitted directly -- candidates apply through their country's Indian Embassy or High Commission, generally at least 3 months before their chosen course's start date, so this is genuinely rolling/ongoing rather than tied to one fixed annual deadline. Course lengths vary from about one week to a few months depending on the subject.
org: Government of India (Ministry of External Affairs)
visaNote: Participants travel on a training/student visa arranged with support from their local Indian Embassy or High Commission; this is short-term training, not employment.
